subject.title: perf: bound publisher profile, membership, and catalog reads

question: What permanent contract should replace the complete-catalog behavior of getPublishedDisplayManifest for large GitHub-backed publishers?
rationale: Code can mechanically add a limit or pagination, but maintainers must decide whether callers require a complete atomic manifest, may consume pages, or may accept an explicitly bounded projection; choosing incorrectly could produce incomplete publisher displays.

options.title: Use a bounded caller API
options.body: Replace the complete manifest with indexed pagination or a purpose-specific bounded projection and update callers to consume that contract.

options.title: Preserve complete manifests
options.body: Keep complete semantics but serve them from explicitly maintained or precomputed state with documented size and failure limits.

options.title: Create a focused follow-up
options.body: Move the remaining path to a dedicated canonical issue only after documenting the chosen completion boundary and linking it here.

recommendation.title: Use a bounded caller API
recommendation.body: Replace the complete manifest with indexed pagination or a purpose-specific bounded projection and update callers to consume that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They implemented the completed stages and explicitly documented the unresolved display-manifest boundary.
